in_sanskrit.name: भगवान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who possesses wealth (of virtues), fortune, and prosperity

in_hindi.name: भगवाना
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bhagavan ke Swami, Param Purush (Lord of God, Supreme Being)

in_tamil.name: பகவானா
in_tamil.meaning: இருதய மற்றும் விருத்தம் ஆகவும் பெரிய வளர்வு, சக்கரம் வளர்ந்த அவர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has a vast mind and intellect, and has the power to give and protect wealth and prosperity

in_telugu.name: భగవానా
in_telugu.long_meaning: Bhagavan, Desham Bhagavanam, Deshya Deshya, Dharma Dharaka, Dharma Dharana Karta (God of Gods, Lord of Lords, Protector of Dharma and Provider of Dharma)

in_marathi.name: Bhagavaana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagavaana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the word ‘Bhagavan’, which means ‘God’ or ‘Lord’. In Hindu mythology, Bhagavaana refers to a divine or godly being. The name evokes feelings of reverence, piety, and awe.
